summary: A verdict pass that a request's read deadline interrupts no longer stops the claim signature migration on a persisted 'signature-state-corrupt' fault that needed `st replication signatures resume`; the paced signature job does the work instead.

replay.detail: No replay or projection change. Verdicts are the same; only who finishes an interrupted pass changes.

schema.detail: No schema, durable claim or projection table changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention, signature or graph digest rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version compatible with the previous release: no wire, claim or admission change, and verdicts are computed the same way on both versions.

downtime.detail: Activating the new binary uses the ordinary managed daemon replacement path.

manual.detail: Only on a member already stopped on a 'verdict reconciliation: interrupted' fault: run `st replication signatures resume --reason TEXT` once after the upgrade. The new binary does not clear an existing fault, and it does not persist this one again. No other member needs anything.

recovery.detail: No persistent format changes or new rollback restrictions. A rolled-back binary can persist the fault again.
